# Calendar

Navigate a date grid, skip unavailable days, and select a civil date.

## Usage

### Month

Navigate and select dates in a complete month grid.

<ComponentExample component="calendar" scenario="month" title="Month" description="Navigate and select dates in a complete month grid." :index="0" />

### Week

Switch to a focused seven-day view while keeping selection and paging available.

<ComponentExample component="calendar" scenario="week" title="Week" description="Switch to a focused seven-day view while keeping selection and paging available." :index="1" />

### Disabled weekends

Keep weekend dates visible while preventing them from becoming the selected date.

<ComponentExample component="calendar" scenario="disabled-weekends" title="Disabled weekends" description="Keep weekend dates visible while preventing them from becoming the selected date." :index="2" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="calendar" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="3" />

## Style available and selected dates

Style availability and selection from the public ARIA state on calendar cells. You do not need a second visual-only list that can drift from the component policies.

```css
[data-scope='calendar'][data-part='cell'][aria-selected='true'] {
  background: CanvasText;
  color: Canvas;
}

[data-scope='calendar'][data-part='cell'][aria-disabled='true'] {
  opacity: .45;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
```

For SSR or tests that need a stable initial month, set the API `referenceDate` so the first rendered view does not depend on the current clock.

## API reference

See [Calendar API](/api/components/calendar) for props, events, slots, public types, part selectors, and keyboard behavior.

## Accessibility

The inline content owns a labeled grid whose cells expose selected, highlighted, unavailable, and outside-month state.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/examples/datepicker-dialog/) for the host accessibility contract.
